description: This file defines a React component called ChatInputPanel, which serves as the input panel in a chat application. It manages user input, handles commands, integrates with hooks for uploading images, prompts, and store states, and provides UI with input area, buttons, and hint prompts.

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls the chat message view to the bottom by updating message render index and invoking scrollDomToBottom.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Handles user input in the textarea, updates state, triggers prompt search and command matching.

methods.name: setMsgRenderIndex
methods.description: Sets the message render index ensuring it stays within valid bounds.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Handles submitting the user input, including command execution, updating store, and resetting input states.
